name: Please Boost Me Over a 2.0!
source:
A chatsim featuring you- a struggling college student barely hanging onto merit based financial aid. Hoping to boost your horrible GPA- you decide to use your winter break to take an online management course. 

Unfortunately, it seems you've been paired with the most incompatible group of people in existence to finish your final paper. A pair of scorned exes, an annoying troll, and you- an introvert with a crippling fear of confrontation. 

With everyone procrastinating till the last second, you four scramble to put together a paper that’s somewhat coherent. Stay up late, beg others to do their parts, and find there’s more to each of you than what meets the eye. 

[From [url=https://iotenny.itch.io/pbmo2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款聊天模拟游戏，主角是一名苦苦挣扎的大学生，勉强靠着基于成绩的经济援助。为了提高你可怕的GPA，你决定利用寒假参加在线管理课程。

不幸的是，你似乎与现存最不兼容的一群人配对来完成你的期末论文。一对被蔑视的前任，一个烦人的巨魔，还有你——一个内向的人，极度害怕对抗。

由于每个人都拖延到最后一秒，你们四个人争先恐后地整理出一篇有点连贯的论文。熬夜，恳求别人尽自己的一份力量，然后发现你们每个人的成就都比表面上看到的要多。

[来自[url=https://iotenny.itch.io/pbmo2]itch.io[/url]]
